description: Bar Plume covers Power BI's five bar charts in one visual: clustered, stacked and 100% stacked, as bars or columns. Put a field in Category, one or more measures in Values and, if you like, a Legend, a Small multiples field or a Target. Long names switch to horizontal bars by themselves. Free features, no watermark Layouts: clustered, stacked, 100% stacked or overlapped; a Legend with several measures is allowed. Small multiples with a shared axis, totals kept in every panel. Hierarchy: drill down, expand all, labels concatenated or grouped under the columns. Series order: by name, total or a custom list, reversed; colors stay with their series. Bars: fixed or maximum width, gaps between segments, ribbons between stacks, rounded ends, scrolling. Labels: value and share of the category, a detail line from a measure, hide small segments, positive and negative totals. Per-series settings, targets, sorting, keyboard, cross-filtering, right-click menu. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. Your colors: follows the report theme; custom colors; Minimal and Black & White styles; high contrast, English and French. Premium features ★ Stacked and clustered columns: one stack per measure, side by side. Diverging bars for agreement scales (Likert), centered on zero. Total of 100% bars, shown as the actual value.
